If this is a self-built node, please enable TLS or other secure encryption, or pin the certificate using pinSHA256. If this is an airport/provider node, please contact your service provider for a technical upgrade. If the provider refuses to cooperate, it is recommended to switch to a service provider that prioritizes user security. For more information, please visit https://github.com/2dust/v2rayN/discussions/9460.
